news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.5% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited announced a financing transaction
news.body: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited announced a private placement of Pre-Funded Convertible Warrants of the company on March 13, 2026. The Warrants are convertible into Common Shares of the company on preferential basis. The transaction has been approved in the Extra Ordinary General Meeting of the Company.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.03 (vs ₹0.063 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.03 (down from ₹0.063 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹633.5m (down 14% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹9.91m (down 50% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.6% (down from 2.7% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 117% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 30% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 50.3965 million in funding from Kamdhenu Limited
news.body: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited announced a private placement to issue 29,645,000 convertible warrants at an issue price of INR 1.7 for the proceeds of INR 50,396,500 on February 12, 2026. The transaction involves participation from Kamdhenu Limited for 29,645,000 shares for 8.62% stake. The Transaction is approved by board of directors and is subject to approval of shareholders and applicable regulatory authorities. The warrants will be convertible into one common share of the company at INR 5.1 per share and will mature in 18 months from the date of the allotment. The securities will be issued on preferential basis.
